note: Only results that were actually measured appear here, each with its source, method and sample size. Add a result only together with the artifact or script that produced it. Nothing here is a projection.

results.what: Accuracy on a held-out star-classification pack (a narrow task, not general astrophysics ability)
results.baseline: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct without the adapter: 148 items only the adapter got right, 20 only the baseline got right (exact McNemar p < 0.001)
results.control: a shuffled-label adapter agreed with the replies on only 104 of 317 items, so the check can fail
results.method: scripts/night_eval.py, temperature 0, seed 7; scripts/night_pack_build.py eval pack
results.caveats: One expert on one narrow pack. The regression gate on other packs (HM-S14-08) has not been run, so this tier is experimental.

results.what: End-to-end request latency through shield, gateway, escrow and ledger (Qwen2.5-Coder 1.5B Q4 on CPU)
results.caveats: Two requests: a smoke test of the metering path, not a benchmark. End-to-end time, not time-to-first-token.

results.what: End-to-end request latency of the plain Granite 3.1 1B-A400M base model (Q4_K_M) on CPU through shield, gateway, escrow and ledger; speed measured with 6 threads
results.hardware: 8 vCPU, no GPU (llama.cpp -ngl 0), about 1.2 GB RAM; generation about 68 tokens/s
results.method: scripts/mvp_e2e_smoke.py --tier granite-1b-base (15 checks, all passed); deploy/granite_cpu/completion.jinja
results.caveats: A base model: it continues text and does not follow instructions. Quality was not measured; in the two test prompts it named Uranus instead of Neptune as a large planet and repeated itself. Two requests: a metering-path smoke test, not a benchmark.
